payload.text: vc, 2026-10-25, on cc's 0227 design question (hv may veto): (1) assets mode is a template the project keeps, with devbin filling only what it reads from the release (version, per-asset sha256, revision, a generated install body); (2) at a cut, the person's yes at the confirm step is the yes for the tap push its after: step makes: the core exports DEVBIN_RELEASE_CONFIRMED=<tag> to after: commands only when confirm was answered at the prompt, never under --yes, and formula publish skips its own ask only for that exact tag; run alone, publish asks. Tighter than today (today's after: publishes with no ask). Not (2) no ask under a cut, (3) a hand publish after each cut, or (4) reopening 0158's nested-dispatcher rule.
